# unifi_setting_snmp (Resource)

Turn SNMP on a site's UniFi devices on or off, the legacy local Network API setting `snmp`. Only the two toggles are managed: the community string and the v3 credentials are secrets and stay as they were set in the UI, so they never reach Terraform state. The setting exists once per site: the resource takes over the existing document, or creates it on a site that has never saved it. Each write sends the document back whole, to preserve the fields it doesn't model, so a field that was absent can become empty but never absent again. Import with `<site_id>`. Destroying the resource only removes it from Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "unifi_site" "default" {
  name = "Default"
}

# Keep SNMP off on every device. The community and v3 credentials are not managed.
resource "unifi_setting_snmp" "default" {
  site_id    = data.unifi_site.default.id
  enabled    = false
  enabled_v3 = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) SNMP v1/v2c on the site's devices.
- `site_id` (String) Integration site UUID.

### Optional

- `enabled_v3` (Boolean) SNMP v3 on the site's devices. Keeps the controller's value when not set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic resource ID equal to `site_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The setting exists once per site: import with the integration site UUID.
terraform import unifi_setting_snmp.default <site_id>
```
